bio: This establishment bang in the heart of the city impresses with its chic baroque decor. On offer is a lineup of Gallic brasserie favourites (eggs mayonnaise, creamy mushroom soup, beef tartare, Argentinean Angus rib steak, magret of duck in a sauce à l’orange, fish with a beurre blanc and others), together with a selection of more high-flying ingredients such as the house signature: ravioles of langoustine, foie gras and truffles. Chavant was the name of the owner's ancestors, restaurateurs since 1852....
